name: clone-lab ground truth
summary: The answer key for the clone-lab corpus: which look-alikes are same-operator mirrors, which are impersonating clones, and which similar-looking pages are genuinely different services that must NOT be merged.
notes: other-market.html shares the market's template but is a different operator (own assets, own keys, different listings) — merging it into the market cluster is a false merge. market-clone-keyless.html is reworded and shows no keys, so only shared assets + structure identify it.
